integrity: Constructive proofs of all-parameter assertions; exact finite base-graph checks are supplied as source code. General assertions do not follow solely from finite data.
limitations: No determination of general diameter, worst-case distortion, all-pairs distance polynomial, spectral gap, or random-walk mixing time. Possible overlap in other restricted-permutation or matching-switch work remains.
scientific_scope: Degree distribution and edge count for all n >= 3; connectivity classification for n >= 3; sharp isometric embedding boundary in connected orders n >= 4; explicit two-step excess witnesses for all n >= 5.
title: Exact local mobility and sharp geodesic failure in derangement switch graphs
